notes: Arctos agreed 20 Aug 2026 to buy up to 10 percent of the Falcons from Arthur Blank (7.5 percent initial tranche) in a deal that implies a 10.6 billion dollar enterprise value. Subject to NFL owner approval expected around Oct 2026.

Mark Walter agreed 12 Aug 2026 to sell his majority equity in the Lakers to Joshua Kushner and Bob Iger in a deal valuing the team at 12.5 billion dollars, a record for a North American sports franchise sale.

Todd Boehly and Mark Walter sold their roughly 25 percent combined stake to majority owner Clearlake Capital for about 950 million pounds on 16 Sept 2026 in a deal that valued Chelsea at about 5 billion pounds including debt. Converted at GBP1 equals USD1.34 per the reported dollar figure; the valuation is an enterprise value that includes club debt, not a pure equity price.

Stan Kroenke agreed on 1 Sept 2026 to buy a controlling interest in the Angels from the Arte Moreno family at a record 4 billion dollar valuation, more than the prior MLB record of 3.9 billion. Moreno retains a minority stake and the deal is expected to close in Q1 2027 pending MLB approval.

Marc Lore agreed on 21 Aug 2026 to sell most of his controlling stake in the Timberwolves and Lynx to Marc Stad at a 4.5 billion dollar valuation for the two franchises together; Alex Rodriguez retains his stake and Lore keeps a minority interest.

EQT agreed 18-19 Aug 2026 to buy an 80 percent stake in Melbourne Storm for a reported A150 million (about 106 million US dollars per Bloomberg), implying a 100 percent value of roughly 133 million US dollars. Other outlets (CODE Sports) reported the outlay as closer to A120 million, so this figure carries real spread and the deal is still subject to Australian Rugby League Commission approval.
